lessons.title: Uno
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy McGill struggles to earn a living as a public defender while caring for his brother Chuck, a brilliant lawyer who avoids electricity. Hoping to attract a wealthy client, Jimmy approaches the Kettlemans, who face an embezzlement investigation. He also challenges HHM over Chuck's place at the firm. A staged accident involving two skateboarders is supposed to generate business, but they target the wrong car. Jimmy follows them to a house and unexpectedly encounters Tuco Salamanca.

lessons.title: Mijo
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy tries to talk Tuco out of killing the skateboarders after their scam insults Tuco's grandmother. His improvised negotiation saves their lives, although they leave with broken legs. The experience introduces Jimmy to Nacho, who sees an opportunity in the Kettlemans' stolen money. Nacho proposes robbing the family and paying Jimmy for information. Jimmy refuses the offer, but his concern about what might happen draws him further into a dangerous situation.

lessons.title: Nacho
lessons.synopsis: The Kettlemans disappear, and Nacho becomes the main suspect. Jimmy agrees to represent him and learns that Nacho's presence near the house may expose a separate crime. lessons.title: Hero
lessons.synopsis: The Kettlemans offer Jimmy money to keep quiet, which he accepts as a supposed retainer. He uses it to copy Howard's appearance and advertise beside an HHM-like logo. The firm demands that the billboard come down. Jimmy then stages a dramatic rescue of a worker hanging from the sign, winning publicity and new enquiries. His success depends on manipulating the story, while Chuck remains unaware of how his brother obtained the attention.

lessons.title: Alpine Shepherd Boy
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy's publicity brings a series of unsuitable clients, from an eccentric would-be sovereign to an inventor with an unfortunate product. An elderly client's will points him toward elder law, where patience and personal attention may provide a viable practice. Chuck is taken to hospital after an encounter outside his home. Jimmy resists treating his brother as incapable of making decisions. The episode links Jimmy's growing business ambitions with his protective, complicated loyalty to Chuck.

examples.en: They proposed an amendment to the bill.
examples.zh: 他们提议修改法案。

examples.en: The Fourth Amendment concerns searches and seizures.
examples.zh: 第四修正案涉及搜查与扣押。

cards.definition_en: A formal change or addition to a document, agreement, or law.

cards.meaning: 强迫性的；带胁迫性质的
cards.usage: 形容词；coerce 是动词，coercion 是名词。

examples.en: They criticized the coercive tactics.
examples.zh: 他们批评了这些胁迫手段。

examples.en: The agreement was reached under coercive conditions.
examples.zh: 协议是在胁迫条件下达成的。

examples.en: A coercive threat can undermine consent.
examples.zh: 胁迫性威胁可能损害同意的有效性。

cards.definition_en: Using threats, force, or pressure to obtain compliance.

cards.meaning: 以预付顾问费方式受聘
cards.usage: 常用于律师或专业顾问，强调持续可提供服务的安排。

examples.en: The company keeps a lawyer on retainer.
examples.zh: 公司长期付费聘用一位律师。

examples.en: She works on retainer for several clients.
examples.zh: 她为几位客户提供长期顾问服务。

examples.en: Do we have an investigator on retainer?
examples.zh: 我们有长期聘用的调查员吗？

cards.definition_en: Employed under an arrangement that secures a professional's services or availability in advance.

lessons.title: Five-O
lessons.synopsis: Philadelphia detectives question Mike about the deaths of two police officers. With Jimmy's help, Mike obtains information about their investigation. He later tells his daughter-in-law Stacey the truth about his son Matty: corrupt colleagues killed him despite his reluctant participation in their scheme. Mike explains his own role in taking revenge. His confession reveals the guilt beneath his controlled manner and why providing for Stacey and Kaylee matters so much to him.

cards.usage: 日常义较宽；具体法律构成因辖区不同，不与 battery 简单等同。

examples.en: The police investigated the alleged assault.
examples.zh: 警方调查了涉嫌袭击事件。

examples.en: The witness described an assault near the station.
examples.zh: 证人描述了车站附近的一起袭击。

examples.en: The lawyer reviewed the assault charge.
examples.zh: 律师审查了袭击指控。

cards.definition_en: A physical attack or, in some legal uses, conduct that creates fear of imminent harm; to attack.

cards.usage: 通常为获得业务或便利而暗中支付；不等于公开折扣。

examples.en: The official accepted a kickback.
examples.zh: 官员收受了回扣。

examples.en: The contract was linked to kickbacks.
examples.zh: 合同与回扣有关。

examples.en: They investigated an alleged kickback scheme.
examples.zh: 他们调查了一项涉嫌回扣的安排。

cards.definition_en: A secret or improper payment given in return for steering business or granting a favor.

cards.usage: 可指物理障碍；司法语境需结合 obstruction of justice。

examples.en: The investigation examined possible obstruction.
examples.zh: 调查审查了可能的妨碍行为。

examples.en: An obstruction blocked the road.
examples.zh: 障碍物堵住了道路。

examples.en: They removed the obstruction to negotiations.
examples.zh: 他们消除了谈判的障碍。

cards.definition_en: Something that blocks progress; also the act of deliberately interfering with a process.

cards.usage: 常作表语；交易 above board 表示没有暗中欺骗。

examples.en: Every payment must be above board.
examples.zh: 每笔付款都必须公开合规。

examples.en: The deal looked above board at first.
examples.zh: 这笔交易起初看起来很正当。

examples.en: Keep the hiring process above board.
examples.zh: 让招聘过程保持公正透明。

cards.definition_en: Honest, open, and conducted according to accepted rules.

cards.usage: put someone on a pedestal 把某人理想化。

examples.en: She put her mentor on a pedestal.
examples.zh: 她把导师理想化了。

examples.en: Don't put any leader on a pedestal.
examples.zh: 别盲目崇拜任何领导者。

examples.en: Being placed on a pedestal made him uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 受到过度崇拜让他不自在。

cards.definition_en: In a position of excessive admiration, as if someone were beyond criticism.

cards.usage: get out of hand 失控；reject out of hand 直接拒绝。

examples.en: The argument got out of hand.
examples.zh: 争论失去了控制。

examples.en: She rejected the proposal out of hand.
examples.zh: 她不加考虑就拒绝了提案。

examples.en: Don't let costs get out of hand.
examples.zh: 别让费用失控。

cards.definition_en: Beyond control; with reject or dismiss, without serious consideration.

cards.usage: 原指美式橄榄球中的孤注一掷长传；a Hail Mary 表示绝境中的尝试。

examples.en: The appeal was a legal Hail Mary.
examples.zh: 这次上诉是法律上的最后一搏。

examples.en: They tried a Hail Mary to save the contract.
examples.zh: 他们孤注一掷地尝试挽救合同。

examples.en: Don't build your strategy around a Hail Mary.
examples.zh: 别把策略押在最后的侥幸一搏上。

cards.definition_en: A desperate final attempt with little chance of success.

cards.usage: 可作名词或动词；也可比喻毫无准备时遭到质问。

examples.en: The convoy drove into an ambush.
examples.zh: 车队驶入了伏击圈。

examples.en: Armed men ambushed the vehicle.
examples.zh: 武装人员伏击了车辆。

examples.en: She felt ambushed by the unexpected questions.
examples.zh: 突如其来的问题让她觉得遭到围攻。

cards.definition_en: A surprise attack from a concealed position; to attack someone in this way.

lessons.title: Bingo
lessons.synopsis: The Kettlemans reject a plea agreement and abandon Kim for Jimmy, threatening Kim's position at HHM. Jimmy discovers that their expectations are impossible to satisfy honestly. He recruits Mike to recover the stolen cash and ensures that it reaches the authorities, including the money Jimmy had accepted. Without the cash as leverage, the family must return to Kim and face the deal. Jimmy protects Kim's work but loses the money and prospects he briefly imagined.

cards.meaning: 侵占；挪用受托管理的财产
cards.usage: 常见于雇员或管理者挪用经手资金的语境；区别于泛指 theft。

examples.en: The accountant was accused of embezzlement.
examples.zh: 会计被指控侵占受托财产。

examples.en: The audit uncovered signs of embezzlement.
examples.zh: 审计发现了挪用资金的迹象。

examples.en: The report examined an embezzlement case.
examples.zh: 报告研究了一起侵占财产案件。

cards.definition_en: The dishonest taking of money or property entrusted to one's care.

cards.meaning: 聘用律师等专业人士的预付费用；聘用安排
cards.usage: 具体如何计费取决于协议；不必然指已赚取的费用。

examples.en: The client paid a retainer before work began.
examples.zh: 客户在工作开始前支付了预付聘用费。

examples.en: Ask what the retainer covers.
examples.zh: 问清预付费用覆盖哪些服务。

examples.en: The firm explained its retainer agreement.
examples.zh: 事务所解释了聘用协议。

cards.definition_en: A fee or arrangement securing a professional's services or availability, especially a lawyer's.

cards.usage: the prosecution 常指刑事案件中的控方。

examples.en: The prosecution presented its evidence.
examples.zh: 控方出示了证据。

examples.en: The defense challenged the prosecution's account.
examples.zh: 辩方质疑了控方的说法。

examples.en: The file was sent for prosecution.
examples.zh: 案卷被移送起诉。

cards.definition_en: The pursuit of criminal charges in court; also the lawyers bringing those charges.

cards.usage: 可数名词或动词；不等于正常服务费或合法报酬。

examples.en: The official refused the bribe.
examples.zh: 那名官员拒绝了贿赂。

examples.en: The employee was accused of accepting a bribe.
examples.zh: 该员工被指控收受贿赂。

examples.en: Nobody should have to bribe someone to receive a public service.
examples.zh: 任何人都不应该靠行贿才能获得公共服务。

cards.definition_en: Something offered to improperly influence a decision; to offer such an inducement.

cards.usage: immunity from prosecution 为免于追诉；具体范围依协议和规则。

examples.en: The witness requested immunity from prosecution.
examples.zh: 证人要求获得追诉豁免。

examples.en: The agreement did not grant blanket immunity.
examples.zh: 协议没有给予全面豁免。

examples.en: Vaccination can build immunity.
examples.zh: 接种疫苗可以建立免疫力。

cards.definition_en: Protection from prosecution or liability in a legal setting; also resistance to disease.

cards.usage: implicate someone in a crime；暗示涉案不等于定罪。

examples.en: The documents implicated a senior official.
examples.zh: 文件牵连到一名高级官员。

examples.en: He refused to implicate his partner.
examples.zh: 他拒绝供出同伙。

examples.en: New evidence implicated the contractor in the fraud.
examples.zh: 新证据显示承包商可能涉及诈骗。

cards.definition_en: To connect someone to wrongdoing or suggest that they were involved.

cards.usage: exonerate someone；不总与法院 acquit 同义。

examples.en: The recording exonerated the driver.
examples.zh: 录音洗清了司机的嫌疑。

examples.en: An independent review exonerated her.
examples.zh: 独立审查免除了她的责任。

examples.en: The evidence did not fully exonerate him.
examples.zh: 证据没有完全洗清他的嫌疑。

cards.definition_en: To clear someone of blame, responsibility, or an accusation.

cards.usage: extradite someone to a country；名词 extradition。

examples.en: Authorities sought to extradite the suspect.
examples.zh: 当局寻求引渡嫌疑人。

examples.en: He was extradited to face trial.
examples.zh: 他被引渡回去受审。

examples.en: The two countries negotiated an extradition treaty.
examples.zh: 两国商谈了引渡条约。

cards.definition_en: To formally transfer a person to another jurisdiction to face criminal proceedings or punishment.

cards.meaning: 承担责任或费用；目标已上钩
cards.usage: on the hook for 后接金额或责任；钓鱼隐喻中也可指已钓到目标。

examples.en: The company is on the hook for repairs.
examples.zh: 公司要承担维修责任。

examples.en: Who's on the hook for the missing money?
examples.zh: 谁要对丢失的钱负责？

examples.en: The salesperson thought he had a buyer on the hook.
examples.zh: 销售员以为已经钓到一个买家。

cards.definition_en: Responsible for a cost or obligation; in a fishing metaphor, caught or drawn in as a target.

cards.usage: plead 后可接 guilty 或 not guilty；区别于单纯承认某个事实。

examples.en: The defendant chose to plead guilty.
examples.zh: 被告选择认罪。

examples.en: She pleaded not guilty at the hearing.
examples.zh: 她在听证时作无罪答辩。

examples.en: The lawyer explained what it meant to plead guilty.
examples.zh: 律师解释了认罪意味着什么。

cards.definition_en: To formally admit guilt to a criminal charge in court.

cards.meaning: 不受旧问题拖累的新起点
cards.usage: start with a clean slate；强调重新开始，不保证过去的法律责任被免除。

examples.en: The new team deserves a clean slate.
examples.zh: 新团队应当获得重新开始的机会。

examples.en: We settled our debts and started with a clean slate.
examples.zh: 我们还清债务，重新起步。

examples.en: Moving away did not give him a clean slate.
examples.zh: 搬走并没有让他摆脱过去。

cards.definition_en: A fresh start without previous mistakes or obligations counting against someone.

lessons.title: Rico
lessons.synopsis: While helping an elderly client, Jimmy notices suspicious charges at Sandpiper Crossing. He investigates the billing, retrieves shredded documents and discovers a possible pattern of financial exploitation. Chuck becomes absorbed in the legal work and helps develop a substantial case. Their collaboration gives Jimmy hope that they can finally work as equals. As the case grows beyond a solo practice, the need for resources creates a new question about who will control it.

cards.meaning: 发现；诉讼中的证据开示
cards.usage: 法律义是审前依法获取对方相关信息的程序，区别于普通“发现”。

examples.en: The parties exchanged documents during discovery.
examples.zh: 双方在证据开示阶段交换了文件。

examples.en: The lawyer requested more time for discovery.
examples.zh: 律师申请延长证据开示时间。

examples.en: The discovery of a leak changed our schedule.
examples.zh: 发现漏水后，我们改变了日程。（普通义。）

cards.definition_en: Finding something previously unknown; in litigation, the process of obtaining and exchanging case information.

cards.usage: 法律义通常用复数；damage 常指损害本身，注意区别。

examples.en: The court awarded damages to the customer.
examples.zh: 法院判给客户损害赔偿金。

examples.en: They are seeking damages for the loss.
examples.zh: 他们正就损失请求赔偿。

examples.en: The storm caused damage, but the claim is for damages.
examples.zh: 暴风雨造成了损害，而索赔请求的是赔偿金。

cards.definition_en: Money awarded to compensate for a legally recognized injury or loss.

cards.usage: 法律或商务语境指欺骗行为；a fraud 也可指骗子或冒牌者。

examples.en: The bank investigated possible fraud.
examples.zh: 银行调查了可能的欺诈行为。

examples.en: The company introduced fraud prevention training.
examples.zh: 公司开展了防欺诈培训。

examples.en: She realized the offer was a fraud.
examples.zh: 她意识到那个邀约是骗局。

cards.definition_en: Deliberate deception intended to obtain a benefit or cause another person's loss.

cards.usage: 法律中可指招揽客户或某类犯罪邀约；须看宾语和场景。

examples.en: The rules restrict direct solicitation of clients.
examples.zh: 规则限制直接招揽客户。

examples.en: The complaint concerned improper solicitation.
examples.zh: 投诉涉及不当招揽行为。

examples.en: They received a solicitation for donations.
examples.zh: 他们收到了募捐请求。

cards.definition_en: The act of requesting business, money, or action; in some legal contexts, urging someone to commit an offense.

cards.usage: 法律术语 spoliation of evidence；不要误认成普通 spoilage。

examples.en: The missing records raised a spoliation issue.
examples.zh: 记录缺失引出了证据毁损问题。

examples.en: The court considered sanctions for spoliation.
examples.zh: 法院考虑对毁损证据进行处罚。

examples.en: A preservation policy can reduce spoliation risks.
examples.zh: 证据保存制度可以降低证据毁损风险。

cards.definition_en: The destruction, alteration, or improper loss of evidence relevant to a legal dispute.

cards.usage: 通常不可数；litigation costs 诉讼费用。

examples.en: The dispute led to years of litigation.
examples.zh: 争议导致多年诉讼。

examples.en: Litigation can be expensive and slow.
examples.zh: 诉讼可能昂贵且漫长。

examples.en: She works in commercial litigation.
examples.zh: 她从事商事诉讼工作。

cards.definition_en: The process of pursuing or defending a dispute through the courts.

cards.meaning: 欺诈以骗取钱财或权利
cards.usage: defraud someone of something；比一般 deceive 更具体。

examples.en: The scheme defrauded investors of millions.
examples.zh: 骗局骗走了投资者数百万资金。

examples.en: He denied intending to defraud the bank.
examples.zh: 他否认有意欺诈银行。

examples.en: Customers were defrauded through false invoices.
examples.zh: 客户因虚假发票而被骗。

cards.definition_en: To obtain money, property, or another benefit from someone through deception.

cards.usage: 与 statue 雕像区分；法律通常是 legislature 制定的 statute。

examples.en: The statute defines the offence.
examples.zh: 成文法界定了该罪。

examples.en: Counsel cited the relevant statute.
examples.zh: 律师引用了相关法条。

examples.en: The claim depends on how the statute is interpreted.
examples.zh: 诉求取决于如何解释该法令。

cards.definition_en: A written law enacted by a legislative body.

cards.meaning: 先例；具有参考或约束意义的判例
cards.usage: set a precedent 开创先例；与 president 总统区分。

examples.en: The ruling set a precedent.
examples.zh: 裁决开创了先例。

examples.en: Counsel cited a relevant precedent.
examples.zh: 律师引用了相关判例。

examples.en: There was no clear precedent for the decision.
examples.zh: 这个决定没有明确先例。

cards.definition_en: An earlier decision or event used as a guide for later similar situations.

cards.usage: 含近乎相反的双义：impose sanctions 施加制裁；sanction a decision 批准。

examples.en: The court sanctioned the lawyer.
examples.zh: 法院处罚了律师。

examples.en: The board refused to sanction the proposal.
examples.zh: 董事会拒绝批准提案。

examples.en: The policy includes sanctions for misconduct.
examples.zh: 政策规定了对不当行为的处罚。

cards.definition_en: An official penalty or approval; as a verb, to penalize or formally authorize, depending on context.

cards.usage: 形容词，evidentiary hearing 专门审查证据问题的听证。

examples.en: The court scheduled an evidentiary hearing.
examples.zh: 法院安排了证据听证。

examples.en: There was an evidentiary gap.
examples.zh: 证据存在缺口。

examples.en: Counsel raised an evidentiary objection.
examples.zh: 律师提出了证据方面的异议。

cards.definition_en: Relating to evidence or the rules governing its use.

cards.usage: 正式词，尤其用于任职或履职时的违法不当行为。

examples.en: The audit uncovered financial malfeasance.
examples.zh: 审计揭露了财务不法行为。

examples.en: She denied any malfeasance in office.
examples.zh: 她否认任职期间存在违法失职。

examples.en: The allegation concerned corporate malfeasance.
examples.zh: 指控涉及企业不法行为。

cards.definition_en: Unlawful or seriously improper conduct, especially by someone holding a position of responsibility.

cards.usage: 比喻直接显示责任或真相的强力证据；不必是实际枪支。

examples.en: The email appeared to be a smoking gun.
examples.zh: 邮件似乎是确凿的关键证据。

examples.en: They searched for a smoking gun.
examples.zh: 他们寻找能一锤定音的证据。

examples.en: A suspicious payment is not always a smoking gun.
examples.zh: 一笔可疑付款未必就是铁证。

cards.definition_en: A piece of evidence that strongly and directly reveals wrongdoing.

cards.meaning: 简易判决；无需完整审判作出的判决
cards.usage: 美国民事程序中通常涉及不存在实质事实争议等条件；不是普通“总结”。

examples.en: The defendant sought summary judgment.
examples.zh: 被告申请简易判决。

examples.en: The court denied summary judgment.
examples.zh: 法院拒绝作出简易判决。

examples.en: The motion argued that summary judgment was appropriate.
examples.zh: 动议主张适合采用简易判决。

cards.definition_en: A decision made without a trial when no genuine dispute of material fact requires one and the law determines the outcome.

lessons.title: Pimento
lessons.synopsis: The Sandpiper case is taken to HHM, but the firm will not hire Jimmy. He initially blames Howard, then discovers that Chuck has been blocking his career. Chuck admits that he does not trust Jimmy with the responsibilities of a lawyer. The revelation breaks their apparent partnership. In a parallel story, Mike protects a nervous pharmaceutical employee during a criminal transaction, demonstrating his practical competence and his ability to distinguish professional discipline from empty intimidation.

cards.usage: 诉讼中常指双方协议解决争议；不等于法院判决。

examples.en: The parties reached a settlement.
examples.zh: 双方达成了和解。

examples.en: They rejected the first settlement offer.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝了第一次和解报价。

examples.en: Is the settlement in writing?
examples.zh: 和解协议有书面形式吗？

cards.definition_en: An agreement resolving a dispute, or the money paid under that agreement.

cards.usage: 法律或商务语境指欺骗行为；a fraud 也可指骗子或冒牌者。

examples.en: The bank investigated possible fraud.
examples.zh: 银行调查了可能的欺诈行为。

examples.en: The company introduced fraud prevention training.
examples.zh: 公司开展了防欺诈培训。

examples.en: She realized the offer was a fraud.
examples.zh: 她意识到那个邀约是骗局。

cards.definition_en: Deliberate deception intended to obtain a benefit or cause another person's loss.

cards.meaning: 有组织的非法牟利活动
cards.usage: 美国法律中常与 RICO 相关；不是所有诈骗都自动属于此类。

examples.en: The indictment included racketeering charges.
examples.zh: 起诉书包含有组织犯罪相关指控。

examples.en: Investigators examined alleged racketeering activity.
examples.zh: 调查人员审查了涉嫌有组织非法牟利的活动。

examples.en: The lecture explained civil racketeering claims.
examples.zh: 讲座解释了相关民事索赔。

cards.definition_en: Carrying out an organized pattern of illegal activity to obtain money or power.

cards.meaning: 庭外宣誓证言；取证问询
cards.usage: 美国诉讼术语，通常在庭前进行并记录，不等于普通访谈。

examples.en: Her deposition lasted four hours.
examples.zh: 她的庭外宣誓问询持续了四小时。

examples.en: Counsel reviewed the deposition transcript.
examples.zh: 律师审阅了证言笔录。

examples.en: He contradicted his earlier deposition.
examples.zh: 他的说法与先前的宣誓证言矛盾。

cards.definition_en: Sworn testimony taken outside the courtroom and recorded for use in a case.

cards.meaning: 先例；具有参考或约束意义的判例
cards.usage: set a precedent 开创先例；与 president 总统区分。

examples.en: The ruling set a precedent.
examples.zh: 裁决开创了先例。

examples.en: Counsel cited a relevant precedent.
examples.zh: 律师引用了相关判例。

examples.en: There was no clear precedent for the decision.
examples.zh: 这个决定没有明确先例。

cards.definition_en: An earlier decision or event used as a guide for later similar situations.

cards.usage: compensate someone for a loss；compensate for a weakness。

examples.en: The company compensated her for the damage.
examples.zh: 公司赔偿了她的损失。

examples.en: Experience can compensate for limited resources.
examples.zh: 经验可以弥补资源不足。

examples.en: Nothing could fully compensate him for the lost time.
examples.zh: 没有什么能完全补偿他失去的时间。

cards.definition_en: To provide payment or another benefit for loss, harm, or work; to make up for a disadvantage.

cards.usage: 由代表成员为具有共同问题的一类人提起的诉讼；资格须依法认定。

examples.en: The customers filed a class action.
examples.zh: 顾客提起了集体诉讼。

examples.en: The court considered whether to certify the class action.
examples.zh: 法院审议是否批准集体诉讼资格。

examples.en: The notice explains who is included in the class action.
examples.zh: 通知解释了哪些人属于集体诉讼成员。

cards.definition_en: A lawsuit brought on behalf of a group whose members have similar legal claims.

cards.meaning: 限制令；禁止特定行为的法院命令
cards.usage: 范围依命令内容；不等于警方的普通口头警告。

examples.en: She applied for a restraining order.
examples.zh: 她申请了限制令。

examples.en: The order prohibited contact.
examples.zh: 命令禁止接触。

examples.en: He was accused of violating a restraining order.
examples.zh: 他被指违反限制令。

cards.definition_en: A court order restricting specified conduct or contact, often to prevent harm or interference.

lessons.title: Marco
lessons.synopsis: Hurt by Chuck's rejection, Jimmy returns to Cicero and reunites with Marco. They revive their old cons, briefly escaping Jimmy's disappointment through familiar routines. Marco dies during their final scam, leaving Jimmy with another personal loss. Back in Albuquerque, a promising opportunity with Davis & Main offers a conventional legal career. Jimmy weighs that path against the freedom and excitement of his former life, questioning whether following the rules has rewarded him.

cards.usage: 形容词 contingent on/upon；名词 a contingent 指一支队伍或代表团。

examples.en: The offer is contingent on approval.
examples.zh: 这项要约以获批为条件。

examples.en: Payment is contingent upon completion.
examples.zh: 付款取决于是否完成。

examples.en: A small contingent attended the hearing.
examples.zh: 一小队代表参加了听证。

cards.definition_en: Dependent on a condition; as a noun, a group representing a larger organization or community.

cards.usage: 法律及正式语境；不等于普通生活压力。

examples.en: She signed the document under duress.
examples.zh: 她在胁迫下签署文件。

examples.en: He said the statement was made under duress.
examples.zh: 他说陈述是在胁迫下作出的。

examples.en: The court examined whether she acted under duress.
examples.zh: 法院审查她是否在胁迫下行动。

cards.definition_en: While being forced or pressured by threats rather than acting freely.

cards.usage: 名词；a betrayal of trust 常用于人际及职业伦理。

examples.en: She regarded the disclosure as a betrayal.
examples.zh: 她把泄密视为背叛。

examples.en: The betrayal damaged their partnership.
examples.zh: 这次背叛损害了他们的合作关系。

examples.en: He struggled to forgive the betrayal of trust.
examples.zh: 他很难原谅这种对信任的辜负。

cards.definition_en: An act that breaks trust or abandons a person or principle.

cards.usage: go off the rails；用于计划、行为或生活。

examples.en: The meeting went off the rails.
examples.zh: 会议失去了控制。

examples.en: His career went off the rails after the scandal.
examples.zh: 丑闻后他的职业生涯偏离正轨。

examples.en: One rumour sent the discussion off the rails.
examples.zh: 一个谣言让讨论跑偏了。

cards.definition_en: Outside normal control or moving in a seriously misguided direction.

cards.usage: earn a livelihood；强调维持生活所依赖的收入来源。

examples.en: The closure threatened their livelihood.
examples.zh: 停业威胁了他们的生计。

examples.en: She earns her livelihood as a translator.
examples.zh: 她靠翻译谋生。

examples.en: They defended the business that provided their livelihood.
examples.zh: 他们维护了赖以谋生的生意。

cards.definition_en: The means by which a person earns enough to live.

cards.usage: 常指车辆被警方或管理机关扣留；动词 impound。

examples.en: Her car was impounded.
examples.zh: 她的车被扣押了。

examples.en: They recovered the impounded vehicle.
examples.zh: 他们取回了被扣押的车辆。

examples.en: Police impounded the van as evidence.
examples.zh: 警方将货车扣作证据。

cards.definition_en: Taken into official custody, often referring to a vehicle seized by authorities.

lessons.title: Switch
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy initially turns down Davis & Main and spends time enjoying the idea of leaving conventional legal work behind. He and Kim con a boastful businessman at a hotel, reminding them both of the appeal of performance and deception. Jimmy ultimately accepts the firm's offer. Meanwhile, Pryce dismisses Mike as his bodyguard and exposes himself to Nacho, who steals his baseball cards. An attempt to recover the collection threatens to attract police attention to Pryce's illegal dealings.

cards.usage: diversify a portfolio；并不保证没有风险。

examples.en: They diversified into consulting.
examples.zh: 他们把业务拓展到咨询领域。

examples.en: She diversified her investments.
examples.zh: 她分散了投资。

examples.en: The firm needs to diversify its client base.
examples.zh: 公司需要让客户来源更多样。

cards.definition_en: To add different activities or investments, often to spread risk.

cards.usage: 已经发生、无法回收的成本；相关谬误是因既有投入而继续错误决策。

examples.en: The old software licence is a sunk cost.
examples.zh: 旧软件许可证费用是沉没成本。

examples.en: Don't let a sunk cost dictate the next decision.
examples.zh: 别让沉没成本支配下一步决定。

examples.en: They treated the initial payment as a sunk cost.
examples.zh: 他们把首付款视为沉没成本。

cards.definition_en: A cost already incurred that cannot be recovered by a future decision.

cards.usage: 不是单纯的事实错误；sunk-cost fallacy 沉没成本谬误。

examples.en: That argument rests on a fallacy.
examples.zh: 这个论证建立在错误推理上。

examples.en: She identified a common fallacy.
examples.zh: 她指出了一个常见谬误。

examples.en: The sunk-cost fallacy can distort decisions.
examples.zh: 沉没成本谬误可能扭曲决策。

cards.definition_en: An error in reasoning or a belief based on faulty reasoning.

cards.usage: 通常复数；pay dividends 也比喻产生好处。

examples.en: The company pays dividends quarterly.
examples.zh: 公司按季度派发股息。

examples.en: Patience can pay dividends.
examples.zh: 耐心可能带来回报。

examples.en: They reinvested the dividends.
examples.zh: 他们将股息再次投入。

cards.definition_en: Payments of company profits to shareholders; figuratively, benefits produced by an effort.

cards.usage: 区别于 heritage 文化遗产；receive an inheritance。

examples.en: She used her inheritance to repay debt.
examples.zh: 她用继承的财产还债。

examples.en: The inheritance caused a family dispute.
examples.zh: 遗产引发了家庭纠纷。

examples.en: He had no expectation of an inheritance.
examples.zh: 他没指望继承财产。

cards.definition_en: Property or money received from someone after their death.

cards.usage: 固定结构 irrespective of，相当于 regardless of，较正式。

examples.en: The rule applies irrespective of age.
examples.zh: 规则不论年龄都适用。

examples.en: They proceeded irrespective of the objections.
examples.zh: 他们不顾反对继续推进。

examples.en: Payment is due irrespective of the outcome.
examples.zh: 无论结果如何都应付款。

cards.definition_en: Used with of to mean without considering or being affected by something.

lessons.title: Cobbler
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy settles into Davis & Main, where an expensive office and professional support come with expectations about his conduct. Mike asks him to help Pryce, whose report of stolen baseball cards has raised police suspicions. Jimmy invents an embarrassing explanation involving private videos to divert the detectives from the real crime. The story works, but Kim is disturbed when she learns what he did. His ingenuity solves an immediate problem while creating a deeper disagreement about professional ethics.

cards.meaning: 发现；诉讼中的证据开示
cards.usage: 法律义是审前依法获取对方相关信息的程序，区别于普通“发现”。

examples.en: The parties exchanged documents during discovery.
examples.zh: 双方在证据开示阶段交换了文件。

examples.en: The lawyer requested more time for discovery.
examples.zh: 律师申请延长证据开示时间。

examples.en: The discovery of a leak changed our schedule.
examples.zh: 发现漏水后，我们改变了日程。（普通义。）

cards.definition_en: Finding something previously unknown; in litigation, the process of obtaining and exchanging case information.

cards.meaning: 传票；以传票要求出庭或提交材料
cards.usage: 法律名词也可作动词；不等同于 arrest warrant 逮捕令。

examples.en: The witness received a subpoena.
examples.zh: 证人收到了传票。

examples.en: The court issued a subpoena for the records.
examples.zh: 法院发出传票，要求提交记录。

examples.en: The lawyer sought to subpoena another witness.
examples.zh: 律师申请以传票传唤另一名证人。

cards.definition_en: A legal command to testify or produce specified material; to issue such a command.

cards.usage: 比暂时 suspension 更严重；动词 disbar。

examples.en: The misconduct could lead to disbarment.
examples.zh: 不当行为可能导致吊销律师资格。

examples.en: He faced disbarment after falsifying records.
examples.zh: 他因伪造记录面临取消执业资格。

examples.en: Disbarment ended her legal practice.
examples.zh: 取消资格终结了她的律师执业。

cards.definition_en: The removal of a lawyer's authorization to practice law.

cards.usage: exonerate someone；不总与法院 acquit 同义。

examples.en: The recording exonerated the driver.
examples.zh: 录音洗清了司机的嫌疑。

examples.en: An independent review exonerated her.
examples.zh: 独立审查免除了她的责任。

examples.en: The evidence did not fully exonerate him.
examples.zh: 证据没有完全洗清他的嫌疑。

cards.definition_en: To clear someone of blame, responsibility, or an accusation.

cards.usage: falsify records；研究中也可指证伪理论，须分语境。

examples.en: The manager falsified expense records.
examples.zh: 经理篡改了费用记录。

examples.en: They were accused of falsifying signatures.
examples.zh: 他们被控伪造签名。

examples.en: One counterexample may falsify the hypothesis.
examples.zh: 一个反例可能证伪该假说。

cards.definition_en: To alter or invent information so that it becomes false or misleading.

cards.meaning: 易波动的；易激动或失控的
cards.usage: 金融、性格、化学中含义不同；volatile situation 不稳定局面。

examples.en: The market became volatile.
examples.zh: 市场变得波动剧烈。

examples.en: He had a volatile temper.
examples.zh: 他脾气易爆。

examples.en: The situation remained volatile.
examples.zh: 局势仍不稳定。

cards.definition_en: Likely to change suddenly or become unstable, angry, or dangerous.

cards.usage: fabricate evidence/story 为贬义；fabricate parts 为中性制造。

examples.en: He fabricated an excuse.
examples.zh: 他编造了一个借口。

examples.en: The witness denied fabricating evidence.
examples.zh: 证人否认伪造证据。

examples.en: The workshop fabricates metal components.
examples.zh: 车间制造金属零件。

cards.definition_en: To invent a false story or evidence; also to manufacture something.

cards.usage: 通常用于 get down to brass tacks，进入实质讨论。

examples.en: Let's get down to brass tacks: what will it cost?
examples.zh: 我们谈实际问题吧：要花多少钱？

examples.en: After lunch, we got down to brass tacks.
examples.zh: 午饭后我们开始谈实质问题。

examples.en: She wanted brass tacks, not another presentation.
examples.zh: 她要的是实际细节，不是又一次演示。

cards.definition_en: The practical facts and essential details of a matter.

lessons.title: Amarillo
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy approaches Sandpiper residents during a bus trip and finds an effective way to recruit clients. He then makes a television commercial and airs it without obtaining approval from the Davis & Main partners. The advertisement generates calls, but its success does not erase the breach of trust. Kim faces consequences at HHM because of her association with him. Separately, Mike considers a job involving Tuco and begins looking for a way to act without committing murder.

cards.usage: 法律义通常用复数；damage 常指损害本身，注意区别。

examples.en: The court awarded damages to the customer.
examples.zh: 法院判给客户损害赔偿金。

examples.en: They are seeking damages for the loss.
examples.zh: 他们正就损失请求赔偿。

examples.en: The storm caused damage, but the claim is for damages.
examples.zh: 暴风雨造成了损害，而索赔请求的是赔偿金。

cards.definition_en: Money awarded to compensate for a legally recognized injury or loss.

cards.usage: 比暂时 suspension 更严重；动词 disbar。

examples.en: The misconduct could lead to disbarment.
examples.zh: 不当行为可能导致吊销律师资格。

examples.en: He faced disbarment after falsifying records.
examples.zh: 他因伪造记录面临取消执业资格。

examples.en: Disbarment ended her legal practice.
examples.zh: 取消资格终结了她的律师执业。

cards.definition_en: The removal of a lawyer's authorization to practice law.

cards.usage: 法律中可指招揽客户或某类犯罪邀约；须看宾语和场景。

examples.en: The rules restrict direct solicitation of clients.
examples.zh: 规则限制直接招揽客户。

examples.en: The complaint concerned improper solicitation.
examples.zh: 投诉涉及不当招揽行为。

examples.en: They received a solicitation for donations.
examples.zh: 他们收到了募捐请求。

cards.definition_en: The act of requesting business, money, or action; in some legal contexts, urging someone to commit an offense.

cards.meaning: 庭外宣誓证言；取证问询
cards.usage: 美国诉讼术语，通常在庭前进行并记录，不等于普通访谈。

examples.en: Her deposition lasted four hours.
examples.zh: 她的庭外宣誓问询持续了四小时。

examples.en: Counsel reviewed the deposition transcript.
examples.zh: 律师审阅了证言笔录。

examples.en: He contradicted his earlier deposition.
examples.zh: 他的说法与先前的宣誓证言矛盾。

cards.definition_en: Sworn testimony taken outside the courtroom and recorded for use in a case.

cards.usage: 常指概念、计划、理由不够清晰。

examples.en: The proposal remained nebulous.
examples.zh: 提案仍然含糊不清。

examples.en: He offered a nebulous explanation.
examples.zh: 他给出了模糊的解释。

examples.en: Their goals were too nebulous to measure.
examples.zh: 他们的目标太模糊，无法衡量。

cards.definition_en: Vague or insufficiently defined to be understood clearly.

cards.usage: 常指两份记录、说法或数字不符。

examples.en: There is a discrepancy between the two invoices.
examples.zh: 两张发票存在差异。

examples.en: The audit found several discrepancies.
examples.zh: 审计发现了几处不一致。

examples.en: Can you explain the discrepancy?
examples.zh: 你能解释这个出入吗？

cards.definition_en: A difference between things that should agree or match.

cards.usage: 动词 intimidate；与合法的强硬谈判并非自动等同。

examples.en: The witness reported intimidation.
examples.zh: 证人报告遭到恐吓。

examples.en: They ruled out tactics based on intimidation.
examples.zh: 他们排除了以威吓为基础的策略。

examples.en: She refused to give in to intimidation.
examples.zh: 她拒绝向恐吓屈服。

cards.definition_en: The use of fear or threats to influence someone's behavior.

cards.usage: 声誉、工作等 on the line 指可能失去；电话语境指在线。

examples.en: My reputation is on the line.
examples.zh: 我的声誉面临风险。

examples.en: Is the client still on the line?
examples.zh: 客户还在线上吗？

examples.en: There's a lot of money on the line.
examples.zh: 有一大笔钱面临风险。

cards.definition_en: At risk of being lost; also connected by telephone.

cards.usage: go out on a limb，常指缺乏支持却为某人担风险。

examples.en: She went out on a limb to recommend him.
examples.zh: 她冒险为他作了推荐。

examples.en: I'm going out on a limb with this prediction.
examples.zh: 我作这个预测是在冒险。

examples.en: Don't leave your colleague out on a limb.
examples.zh: 别让同事孤立无援地承担风险。

cards.definition_en: Taking a personal risk by supporting a position or acting without reliable backing.

lessons.title: Gloves Off
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy faces discipline over the unauthorized commercial, while Kim is pushed into document review at HHM. His attempts to defend her risk making matters worse. Mike rejects Nacho's request to kill Tuco and develops a different plan: provoke Tuco into assaulting him in front of the police. The operation puts Tuco in custody and leaves Mike badly injured. Mike gets the result he wanted, but the Salamancas' influence means the conflict cannot end with the arrest.

cards.usage: 美国刑事分类用语；具体定义和后果依司法辖区及法律而定。

examples.en: He was charged with a felony.
examples.zh: 他被控犯有重罪。

examples.en: The form asks about felony convictions.
examples.zh: 表格询问是否有重罪定罪记录。

examples.en: The lawyer explained the difference between a felony and a misdemeanor.
examples.zh: 律师解释了重罪和轻罪的区别。

cards.definition_en: A serious category of crime, generally carrying more severe penalties than a misdemeanor.

cards.usage: 以威胁迫使对方交钱或作出利益让步。

examples.en: The messages were evidence of extortion.
examples.zh: 这些信息是勒索的证据。

examples.en: He reported the extortion attempt.
examples.zh: 他报告了这次勒索企图。

examples.en: Prosecutors charged the group with extortion.
examples.zh: 检方以敲诈勒索指控该团伙。

cards.definition_en: Obtaining money or cooperation through threats or coercion.

cards.usage: 常见 erratic behaviour/driving；不是一般 unusual。

examples.en: His erratic behaviour worried the team.
examples.zh: 他反复无常的行为让团队担心。

examples.en: The engine ran erratically.
examples.zh: 发动机运转不稳定。

examples.en: Erratic payments disrupted cash flow.
examples.zh: 不规律的付款扰乱了现金流。

cards.definition_en: Changing unpredictably rather than following a consistent pattern.

cards.usage: vouch for someone/something，介词 for。

examples.en: I can vouch for her reliability.
examples.zh: 我可以保证她可靠。

examples.en: Nobody could vouch for the document's authenticity.
examples.zh: 没人能保证文件真实。

examples.en: He vouched for me when I applied.
examples.zh: 我申请时，他为我作了担保。

cards.definition_en: To personally confirm that someone or something is trustworthy or genuine, usually with for.

cards.usage: 通常用于 get down to brass tacks，进入实质讨论。

examples.en: Let's get down to brass tacks: what will it cost?
examples.zh: 我们谈实际问题吧：要花多少钱？

lessons.title: Rebecca
lessons.synopsis: A flashback shows how easily Jimmy charms Chuck's wife Rebecca, highlighting the tension between the brothers. In the present, Kim works relentlessly to bring Mesa Verde to HHM, hoping to restore her standing. Winning the client does not immediately free her from punishment. Hector pressures Mike to change his account of Tuco's arrest. Jimmy's effort to navigate office rules and Mike's negotiations both show how powerful people impose conditions on those beneath them.

cards.meaning: 聘用律师等专业人士的预付费用；聘用安排
cards.usage: 具体如何计费取决于协议；不必然指已赚取的费用。

examples.en: The client paid a retainer before work began.
examples.zh: 客户在工作开始前支付了预付聘用费。

examples.en: Ask what the retainer covers.
examples.zh: 问清预付费用覆盖哪些服务。

examples.en: The firm explained its retainer agreement.
examples.zh: 事务所解释了聘用协议。

cards.definition_en: A fee or arrangement securing a professional's services or availability, especially a lawyer's.

cards.usage: 可用于刑事或民事案件；不是所有案件里的被告都已被定罪。

examples.en: The defendant denied the allegation.
examples.zh: 被告否认了指控。

examples.en: How many defendants are named in the case?
examples.zh: 这个案件列了多少名被告？

cards.definition_en: The person or organization against whom a criminal charge or civil claim is brought.

examples.en: The employee was accused of accepting a bribe.
examples.zh: 该员工被指控收受贿赂。

examples.en: Nobody should have to bribe someone to receive a public service.
examples.zh: 任何人都不应该靠行贿才能获得公共服务。

cards.definition_en: Something offered to improperly influence a decision; to offer such an inducement.

examples.zh: 警方调查了涉嫌袭击事件。

examples.zh: 证人描述了车站附近的一起袭击。

cards.definition_en: A physical attack or, in some legal uses, conduct that creates fear of imminent harm; to attack.

examples.en: He reported the extortion attempt.
examples.zh: 他报告了这次勒索企图。

examples.en: Prosecutors charged the group with extortion.
examples.zh: 检方以敲诈勒索指控该团伙。

cards.definition_en: Obtaining money or cooperation through threats or coercion.

cards.meaning: 庭外宣誓证言；取证问询

examples.en: Her deposition lasted four hours.
examples.zh: 她的庭外宣誓问询持续了四小时。

examples.en: Counsel reviewed the deposition transcript.
examples.zh: 律师审阅了证言笔录。

examples.en: He contradicted his earlier deposition.
examples.zh: 他的说法与先前的宣誓证言矛盾。

cards.definition_en: Sworn testimony taken outside the courtroom and recorded for use in a case.

cards.usage: 可作名词或动词；有时暗含绕过问题。

examples.en: She handled the dispute with finesse.
examples.zh: 她巧妙地处理了争端。

examples.en: He tried to finesse the awkward question.
examples.zh: 他试图巧妙避开这个尴尬问题。

examples.en: The negotiation required considerable finesse.
examples.zh: 谈判需要高超的手腕。

cards.definition_en: Skillful, tactful handling of a difficult situation; to handle something with that skill.

cards.usage: 美国地方刑事检控职务；具体职责随司法辖区而异。

examples.en: The district attorney announced the charges.
examples.zh: 地方检察官宣布了指控。

examples.en: She works in the district attorney's office.

cards.definition_en: A public official responsible for prosecuting crimes in a local jurisdiction in the United States.

cards.meaning: 简易判决；无需完整审判作出的判决
cards.usage: 美国民事程序中通常涉及不存在实质事实争议等条件；不是普通“总结”。

examples.en: The defendant sought summary judgment.
examples.zh: 被告申请简易判决。

lessons.title: Bali Ha'i
lessons.synopsis: Kim receives an offer from Schweikart & Cokely and considers what a different firm might mean for her future. Jimmy continues to test the limits of his position at Davis & Main. Mike faces escalating pressure from Hector, including a threat involving his family. He negotiates payment in exchange for changing his statement about Tuco. The apparent agreement protects his immediate interests, but Mike remains unwilling to accept the Salamancas' power over his life.

cards.meaning: 庭外宣誓证言；取证问询
cards.usage: 美国诉讼术语，通常在庭前进行并记录，不等于普通访谈。

examples.en: Her deposition lasted four hours.
examples.zh: 她的庭外宣誓问询持续了四小时。

examples.en: Counsel reviewed the deposition transcript.
examples.zh: 律师审阅了证言笔录。

examples.zh: 他的说法与先前的宣誓证言矛盾。

cards.definition_en: Sworn testimony taken outside the courtroom and recorded for use in a case.

cards.usage: 与 statue 雕像区分；法律通常是 legislature 制定的 statute。

examples.zh: 律师引用了相关法条。

examples.en: The claim depends on how the statute is interpreted.
examples.zh: 诉求取决于如何解释该法令。

cards.definition_en: A written law enacted by a legislative body.

cards.meaning: 初步的；正式程序之前的
cards.usage: preliminary hearing 初步听证；不等于最终结果。

examples.zh: 初步结果尚无定论。

examples.en: A preliminary hearing was scheduled.
examples.zh: 初步听证已经安排。

examples.en: They held preliminary discussions.
examples.zh: 他们进行了初步讨论。

cards.definition_en: Taking place before the main action or final decision.

cards.usage: diversify a portfolio；并不保证没有风险。

examples.en: They diversified into consulting.
examples.zh: 他们把业务拓展到咨询领域。

examples.en: She diversified her investments.
examples.zh: 她分散了投资。

examples.en: The firm needs to diversify its client base.
examples.zh: 公司需要让客户来源更多样。

cards.definition_en: To add different activities or investments, often to spread risk.

cards.usage: 带强烈负面评价；特定法律中的无行为能力需看语境。

examples.en: The review described the management as incompetent.
examples.zh: 审查认为管理层不称职。

examples.en: One error does not make her incompetent.
examples.zh: 一个错误不意味着她不胜任。

examples.en: He denied being incompetent to handle the case.
examples.zh: 他否认自己没有能力处理此案。

cards.definition_en: Lacking the ability or skill needed to perform a task properly.

cards.usage: 动词 intimidate；与合法的强硬谈判并非自动等同。

examples.en: The witness reported intimidation.
examples.zh: 证人报告遭到恐吓。

examples.en: They ruled out tactics based on intimidation.
examples.zh: 他们排除了以威吓为基础的策略。

examples.en: She refused to give in to intimidation.
examples.zh: 她拒绝向恐吓屈服。

cards.definition_en: The use of fear or threats to influence someone's behavior.

cards.meaning: 承担责任或费用；目标已上钩

examples.zh: 谁要对丢失的钱负责？

examples.en: The salesperson thought he had a buyer on the hook.
examples.zh: 销售员以为已经钓到一个买家。

cards.context: 本集用于钓鱼隐喻：已经钓到一个上钩的目标，不是承担法律责任。
cards.definition_en: Drawn in as a potential target or customer, using the image of a fish caught on a hook.

cards.usage: 美国地方刑事检控职务；具体职责随司法辖区而异。

examples.en: The district attorney announced the charges.
examples.zh: 地方检察官宣布了指控。

examples.zh: 地方检察官审查了证据。

cards.definition_en: A public official responsible for prosecuting crimes in a local jurisdiction in the United States.

lessons.title: Inflatable
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy wants to leave Davis & Main without losing his bonus, so he makes himself increasingly difficult to keep. His deliberately disruptive behaviour finally gets him fired. He proposes starting a practice with Kim, who prefers separate businesses sharing an office and expenses. The arrangement offers closeness without complete professional dependence. Mike changes his statement about Tuco while planning his own response to Hector. Both men seek independence through carefully calculated compromises.

cards.usage: 诉讼中常指双方协议解决争议；不等于法院判决。

examples.en: The parties reached a settlement.
examples.zh: 双方达成了和解。

examples.en: They rejected the first settlement offer.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝了第一次和解报价。

examples.en: Is the settlement in writing?
examples.zh: 和解协议有书面形式吗？

cards.definition_en: An agreement resolving a dispute, or the money paid under that agreement.

cards.usage: 通常不可数；litigation costs 诉讼费用。

examples.en: The dispute led to years of litigation.
examples.zh: 争议导致多年诉讼。

examples.zh: 诉讼可能昂贵且漫长。

examples.en: She works in commercial litigation.
examples.zh: 她从事商事诉讼工作。

cards.definition_en: The process of pursuing or defending a dispute through the courts.

cards.meaning: 法证的；用于司法鉴定的
cards.usage: forensic accountant 法务会计；不局限于尸体或刑侦。

examples.en: A forensic accountant traced the payments.
examples.zh: 法务会计追查了款项。

examples.en: The team examined forensic evidence.
examples.zh: 团队审查了法证证据。

examples.en: Forensic analysis contradicted the initial report.
examples.zh: 法证分析与初步报告矛盾。

cards.definition_en: Relating to scientific investigation used to answer legal questions.

cards.usage: in hindsight 回头来看；常提醒当时无法知道结果。

examples.en: In hindsight, the warning was clear.
examples.zh: 事后看来，警告很明确。

examples.en: Hindsight made the decision look easy.
examples.zh: 事后认识使这个决定看起来很简单。

examples.en: We should not judge only with hindsight.
examples.zh: 我们不应仅凭事后认识来评判。

cards.definition_en: Understanding of an event gained after its outcome is known.

cards.usage: 注意双义：submit a resignation 与 a sigh of resignation。

examples.en: She submitted her resignation.
examples.zh: 她提交了辞呈。

examples.en: He accepted the result with resignation.
examples.zh: 他无奈地接受了结果。

examples.en: The board requested his resignation.
examples.zh: 董事会要求他辞职。

cards.definition_en: The act of leaving a job or position; also acceptance of an unwanted situation.

cards.usage: 美式口语；强调靠小骗局或欺诈谋生的人。

examples.en: The supposed investor was a grifter.
examples.zh: 所谓的投资者其实是骗子。

examples.en: A grifter exploited their generosity.
examples.zh: 一个骗子利用了他们的慷慨。

examples.en: The story follows two ageing grifters.
examples.zh: 故事讲述两个年迈的职业骗子。

cards.definition_en: A person who makes money by manipulating or deceiving others.

cards.usage: 正式词，尤其用于任职或履职时的违法不当行为。

examples.en: The audit uncovered financial malfeasance.
examples.zh: 审计揭露了财务不法行为。

examples.en: She denied any malfeasance in office.
examples.zh: 她否认任职期间存在违法失职。

examples.en: The allegation concerned corporate malfeasance.
examples.zh: 指控涉及企业不法行为。

cards.definition_en: Unlawful or seriously improper conduct, especially by someone holding a position of responsibility.

cards.usage: 指个人或其他利益可能影响应履行的职责；不只是意见不一致。

examples.en: Please disclose any conflict of interest.
examples.zh: 请披露任何利益冲突。

examples.en: She stepped aside because of a conflict of interest.
examples.zh: 她因利益冲突而退出。

examples.en: Could accepting this gift create a conflict of interest?
examples.zh: 收这份礼物会产生利益冲突吗？

cards.definition_en: A situation in which competing interests may interfere with impartial judgment or duties.

cards.meaning: 不受旧问题拖累的新起点
cards.usage: start with a clean slate；强调重新开始，不保证过去的法律责任被免除。

examples.en: The new team deserves a clean slate.
examples.zh: 新团队应当获得重新开始的机会。

examples.en: We settled our debts and started with a clean slate.
examples.zh: 我们还清债务，重新起步。

examples.en: Moving away did not give him a clean slate.
examples.zh: 搬走并没有让他摆脱过去。

cards.definition_en: A fresh start without previous mistakes or obligations counting against someone.

lessons.title: Fifi
lessons.synopsis: Kim leaves HHM and secures Mesa Verde for her new practice, but Chuck and Howard persuade the bank to stay with their firm. While caring for Chuck, Jimmy alters numbers in the bank's documents to undermine his brother's work. Mike studies Hector's operations and prepares to disrupt a transport route. The episode contrasts careful professional presentations with hidden interference, as Jimmy's desire to help Kim leads him to commit a serious violation of trust.

cards.usage: compliance with rules；商务中常指满足监管要求。

examples.en: The audit checked compliance with safety rules.
examples.zh: 审计检查了对安全规则的遵守情况。

examples.en: She works in regulatory compliance.
examples.zh: 她从事监管合规工作。

examples.en: Compliance requires more than signing a form.
examples.zh: 合规不只是签一张表。

cards.definition_en: The act of following a rule, requirement, or instruction.

cards.usage: 注意双义：submit a resignation 与 a sigh of resignation。

examples.en: She submitted her resignation.
examples.zh: 她提交了辞呈。

examples.en: He accepted the result with resignation.
examples.zh: 他无奈地接受了结果。

examples.en: The board requested his resignation.
examples.zh: 董事会要求他辞职。

cards.definition_en: The act of leaving a job or position; also acceptance of an unwanted situation.

cards.usage: 原指美式橄榄球中的孤注一掷长传；a Hail Mary 表示绝境中的尝试。

examples.en: The appeal was a legal Hail Mary.
examples.zh: 这次上诉是法律上的最后一搏。

examples.en: They tried a Hail Mary to save the contract.
examples.zh: 他们孤注一掷地尝试挽救合同。

examples.en: Don't build your strategy around a Hail Mary.
examples.zh: 别把策略押在最后的侥幸一搏上。

cards.definition_en: A desperate final attempt with little chance of success.

cards.meaning: 平等主义的；主张人人平等的
cards.usage: egalitarian society/approach；与单纯 identical 相同区分。

examples.en: They adopted an egalitarian pay structure.
examples.zh: 他们采用了平等主义的薪酬结构。

examples.en: She favours a more egalitarian society.
examples.zh: 她支持一个更平等的社会。

examples.en: The team described its culture as egalitarian.
examples.zh: 团队称自己的文化强调平等。

cards.definition_en: Supporting equal rights and opportunities for people; a person who holds that view.

cards.meaning: 投资组合；业务或作品集
cards.usage: 金融语境指持有的投资组合；也用于客户、项目或创作作品。

examples.en: She reviewed her investment portfolio.
examples.zh: 她审视了自己的投资组合。

examples.en: The firm has a diverse client portfolio.
examples.zh: 公司的客户组合很多样。

examples.en: He submitted a portfolio of design work.
examples.zh: 他提交了一份设计作品集。

cards.definition_en: A collection of investments, work samples, or business activities managed together.

cards.usage: 美国语境常见 interstate commerce；也可作名词指州际公路。

examples.en: The case involved interstate commerce.
examples.zh: 此案涉及州际商业活动。

examples.en: They operate an interstate transport service.
examples.zh: 他们运营州际运输服务。

examples.en: We joined the interstate outside town.
examples.zh: 我们在城外驶上州际公路。

cards.definition_en: Connecting or involving different states; as a noun, an interstate highway.

cards.meaning: 结果难料的；险些失败的
cards.usage: 通常作表语，强调危险或成败未定。

examples.en: It was touch-and-go for a while.
examples.zh: 有一阵子情况很悬。

examples.en: The rescue remained touch-and-go.
examples.zh: 营救结果仍难以预料。

examples.en: Getting the deal signed was touch-and-go.
examples.zh: 能否签下交易一度很悬。

cards.definition_en: Uncertain and risky, with success or survival still in doubt.

lessons.title: Nailed
lessons.synopsis: Chuck's Mesa Verde application fails because of the altered address. He becomes convinced that Jimmy manipulated the documents, while Kim benefits from the bank's renewed interest. Jimmy pressures a copy-shop employee to support his version of events. Chuck investigates in person and collapses, forcing Jimmy to choose between concealment and helping him. Mike successfully robs a Salamanca truck, but learns that an innocent witness was killed afterward, changing his assessment of what the operation achieved.

cards.usage: 美国刑事分类用语；具体定义和后果依司法辖区及法律而定。

examples.zh: 他被控犯有重罪。

examples.zh: 表格询问是否有重罪定罪记录。

examples.en: The lawyer explained the difference between a felony and a misdemeanor.
examples.zh: 律师解释了重罪和轻罪的区别。

cards.definition_en: A serious category of crime, generally carrying more severe penalties than a misdemeanor.

cards.usage: 法律或商务语境指欺骗行为；a fraud 也可指骗子或冒牌者。

examples.zh: 银行调查了可能的欺诈行为。

examples.en: The company introduced fraud prevention training.
examples.zh: 公司开展了防欺诈培训。

examples.en: She realized the offer was a fraud.
examples.zh: 她意识到那个邀约是骗局。

cards.definition_en: Deliberate deception intended to obtain a benefit or cause another person's loss.

cards.meaning: 伪造文件或签名；伪造品
cards.usage: 与诈骗 fraud 不完全相同；可指行为或具体伪造物。

examples.en: The signature was a forgery.
examples.zh: 签名是伪造的。

examples.en: He faced a charge of forgery.
examples.zh: 他面临伪造罪指控。

examples.en: Experts examined the document for forgery.
examples.zh: 专家检查文件是否存在伪造。

cards.definition_en: The making of a false document or signature to deceive; also the false item itself.

cards.meaning: 欺诈以骗取钱财或权利
cards.usage: defraud someone of something；比一般 deceive 更具体。

examples.en: The scheme defrauded investors of millions.
examples.zh: 骗局骗走了投资者数百万资金。

examples.en: He denied intending to defraud the bank.
examples.zh: 他否认有意欺诈银行。

examples.en: Customers were defrauded through false invoices.
examples.zh: 客户因虚假发票而被骗。

cards.definition_en: To obtain money, property, or another benefit from someone through deception.

cards.usage: 比 opponent 更强调敌对或竞争关系；adversary 与 adviser 不同。

examples.zh: 她尊重法庭上的对手。

examples.en: A former ally became his strongest adversary.
examples.zh: 昔日盟友成了他最强的对手。

examples.en: Know what your adversary wants.
examples.zh: 弄清对手想要什么。

cards.definition_en: A person or group you compete or fight against.

cards.usage: 等待进一步确认或满足条件；provisional approval。

examples.en: They reached a provisional agreement.
examples.zh: 他们达成了暂定协议。

examples.en: Her acceptance was provisional.
examples.zh: 对她的录取是有条件的暂定安排。

examples.en: The figures remain provisional.
examples.zh: 这些数字仍属暂定。

cards.definition_en: Temporary and subject to later confirmation or change.

cards.usage: 金融 leverage 指用借入资金扩大敞口；谈判中指筹码。

examples.zh: 银行降低了杠杆比率。

examples.en: They used the deadline as leverage.
examples.zh: 他们把截止日期当作谈判筹码。

examples.en: High leverage can amplify losses.
examples.zh: 高杠杆可能放大损失。

cards.definition_en: The use of borrowed money to finance assets, increasing both potential returns and financial risk.

cards.usage: 常指两份记录、说法或数字不符。

examples.en: There is a discrepancy between the two invoices.
examples.zh: 两张发票存在差异。

examples.en: The audit found several discrepancies.
examples.zh: 审计发现了几处不一致。

examples.en: Can you explain the discrepancy?
examples.zh: 你能解释这个出入吗？

cards.definition_en: A difference between things that should agree or match.

cards.usage: falsify records；研究中也可指证伪理论，须分语境。

examples.zh: 经理篡改了费用记录。

examples.en: The adjournment gave both sides more time.
examples.zh: 延期给了双方更多时间。

examples.en: The judge refused another adjournment.
examples.zh: 法官拒绝再次延期。

cards.definition_en: A pause or postponement in a meeting or court proceeding.

cards.meaning: 破门或非法进入建筑的行为
cards.usage: 法律定性依地区及具体事实；不是任何“进入”都构成该罪。

examples.zh: 警方发现了非法闯入的证据。

examples.en: The charge involved breaking and entering.
examples.zh: 指控涉及非法闯入建筑。

examples.en: An unlocked door does not automatically settle a breaking-and-entering case.
examples.zh: 门没锁并不能自动决定非法闯入案的结论。

cards.definition_en: Unlawfully entering a building, traditionally involving some form of force to gain entry.

lessons.title: Klick
lessons.synopsis: Chuck recovers after his collapse and presents himself as unable to continue practising law. Worried about his brother, Jimmy admits to altering the Mesa Verde documents. Chuck has secretly recorded the confession, turning an act of reassurance into potential evidence. Meanwhile, Mike prepares to shoot Hector but is interrupted by a warning left on his car. The season ends with both men's plans checked by opponents who understand more than they expected.

cards.usage: 美国刑事分类用语；具体定义和后果依司法辖区及法律而定。

examples.en: The lawyer explained the difference between a felony and a misdemeanor.

cards.definition_en: A serious category of crime, generally carrying more severe penalties than a misdemeanor.

examples.zh: 他因伪造记录面临取消执业资格。

examples.en: Disbarment ended her legal practice.
examples.zh: 取消资格终结了她的律师执业。

cards.definition_en: The removal of a lawyer's authorization to practice law.

cards.usage: 法律术语，与 custody 的范围并不完全相同。

examples.en: The family sought temporary guardianship.
examples.zh: 家属申请临时监护。

examples.en: The court reviewed the guardianship arrangement.
examples.zh: 法院审查了监护安排。

examples.en: Guardianship can involve substantial responsibilities.
examples.zh: 监护可能涉及重大责任。

cards.definition_en: Legal responsibility for caring for another person or managing their affairs.

cards.usage: 可作名词或动词；informed consent 是知情同意。

examples.en: They acted without her consent.
examples.zh: 他们未经她同意就采取了行动。

examples.en: He consented to the interview.
examples.zh: 他同意接受采访。

examples.en: The form asks for informed consent.
examples.zh: 表格要求取得知情同意。

cards.usage: 可数名词；a concussion，常用于受伤及医疗场景。

examples.en: The player suffered a concussion.
examples.zh: 球员发生了脑震荡。

examples.en: Doctors checked him for a concussion.
examples.zh: 医生检查他是否有脑震荡。

examples.en: She needed time to recover from the concussion.
examples.zh: 她需要时间从脑震荡中恢复。

examples.zh: 镇静剂的作用开始消退。

cards.definition_en: The removal of a lawyer's authorization to practice law.

cards.usage: corroborate an account；比重复某人的说法更强调独立支持。

examples.en: The receipt corroborated her account.
examples.zh: 收据佐证了她的说法。

examples.en: No witness could corroborate the claim.
examples.zh: 没有证人能佐证该主张。

cards.usage: 本学习册主要关注律师暂停执业；suspended 是相关形容词或过去分词。

cards.definition_en: Relating to evidence or the rules governing its use.

examples.zh: 最后两位数字被调换了。

examples.zh: 她把名字的位置弄反了。

examples.en: A transposed number changed the address.
examples.zh: 一个位置颠倒的数字改变了地址。

cards.definition_en: Placed in a different order or position, especially with two items exchanged.

cards.usage: 常搭配 adverse effect、adverse ruling、adverse party。

examples.zh: 该政策对小企业产生了不利影响。

examples.zh: 他们对不利裁定提出上诉。

examples.en: We must disclose adverse information.
examples.zh: 我们必须披露不利信息。

examples.en: An allegation is not a conviction.
examples.zh: 指控不等于定罪。

examples.en: Investigators examined allegations of bribery.
examples.zh: 调查人员审查了有关行贿的指控。

cards.definition_en: A claim of wrongdoing that has not yet been established as true.

examples.zh: 她在宣誓后作出了那份陈述。

examples.en: Were you under oath when you said that?

examples.zh: 证人在交叉询问中难以应对。

examples.zh: 交叉询问揭露了一处矛盾。

examples.zh: 她为交叉询问作了充分准备。

examples.zh: 他拿着赃物笔记本，被抓个正着。

examples.en: The video gave them the suspect dead to rights.
examples.zh: 录像让他们掌握了嫌疑人的确凿把柄。

cards.definition_en: In a situation where clear evidence establishes someone's wrongdoing.

lessons.title: Off Brand
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy receives a one-year suspension and tries to recover the cost of television airtime he can no longer use to advertise legal services. He creates a new advertising business under the name Saul Goodman. Chuck struggles with the aftermath of the hearing. Nacho fears Hector's plan to involve his father's business and begins considering a way to remove the threat. Gus and Mike continue to develop their working relationship around shared practical interests.

cards.meaning: 体现抱负或理想目标的

examples.zh: 口号表达的是理想目标，难以量化。

examples.zh: 她说这个目标体现了未来的抱负。

examples.en: An aspirational brand sells an imagined lifestyle.
examples.zh: 有向往感的品牌销售的是一种理想生活方式。

cards.definition_en: Expressing a desired future identity, achievement, or standard.

cards.usage: 法律与商务中指反复使用的模板文字，通常不可数。

examples.zh: 别忽视那些法律模板条款。

examples.zh: 把套话换成具体解释。

cards.usage: 通常不可数；强调吸引并影响他人的能力。

examples.en: Her charisma helped win over the audience.
examples.zh: 她的个人魅力帮助她赢得了听众。

examples.en: Charisma cannot replace careful preparation.
examples.zh: 个人魅力不能代替充分准备。

cards.definition_en: A personal appeal that attracts attention and inspires loyalty.

cards.definition_en: A temporary removal from a role, activity, or professional practice.

cards.meaning: 合法正当的；真实合理的

examples.zh: 他们经营合法生意。

examples.zh: 我们核查了文件是否真实有效。

cards.usage: 常见 premeditated murder；强调行动前已有计划。

examples.zh: 检方主张该行为是预谋的。

examples.en: It was not a premeditated decision.
examples.zh: 这个决定并非预先策划。

examples.en: Evidence suggested a premeditated attack.
examples.zh: 证据显示袭击可能早有预谋。

cards.definition_en: Planned in advance rather than done on impulse.

lessons.title: Expenses
lessons.synopsis: Suspended from practising law, Jimmy juggles community service, advertising sales and mounting expenses. Selling television commercials proves much harder than persuading legal clients. Nacho seeks empty capsules as part of his plan against Hector, and Mike becomes involved reluctantly. Kim continues her demanding Mesa Verde work. When Jimmy asks his malpractice insurer for financial relief, he reveals damaging information about Chuck, creating consequences that extend beyond his own immediate money problems.

examples.zh: 客户提出了专业过失索赔。

examples.zh: 她的保单承保律师专业过失。

examples.en: An unfavourable result alone does not prove malpractice.
examples.zh: 结果不利本身并不能证明专业失当。

cards.definition_en: Professional negligence or misconduct that harms a client or patient.

cards.meaning: 尽职调查；应有的审慎核查
cards.usage: 商务常指交易前查验信息；法律中也可强调合理审慎。

examples.zh: 别因为价格低就跳过尽职调查。

cards.definition_en: Careful checking of facts, risks, and obligations before making a decision or completing a transaction.

cards.usage: bar 在此指法律职业及其管理体系；不是酒吧或普通庭审。

examples.zh: 律师纪律听证审查了职业不当行为。

examples.zh: 他为律师纪律听证准备证人。

examples.en: A bar hearing can affect a lawyer's licence.

examples.zh: 他们要求访客签署权利放弃声明。

examples.zh: 声明涵盖了一些风险。

examples.zh: 公司报销了她的差旅费用。

examples.en: Keep the receipts to be reimbursed.
examples.zh: 保留收据以便报销。

examples.en: They agreed to reimburse the deposit.
examples.zh: 他们同意退还垫付款。

examples.zh: 语言习得需要持续接触。

lessons.title: Slip
lessons.synopsis: Jimmy pressures a music shop into compensating him after its owners refuse to pay for the commercial arrangement he expected. Kim takes on additional work and struggles to balance ambition with exhaustion. Chuck makes visible progress in managing daily life outside his house. Nacho prepares the capsule switch that could affect Hector's health, while Mike pursues a way to support his family financially. Small tactical successes coexist with mounting pressure across the characters' lives.
